newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND O/N RATES NARROW, WEEKLY UP.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND O/N RATES NARROW, WEEKLY UP.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed in a still-short private sector market on Monday to between nine and 9-1/2 percent from Sunday's range of 8-7/8 and 9-3/4 percent, bankers said.
"The market has been short since last week, when the Central Bank withdrew 300 million pounds from the market in a t-bill auction," one banker said.
The Central Bank accepted bills worth 1,099.350 million pounds to replace bills worth 702.375 million.
Average one-week rates rose to between nine and 9-1/2 percent against Sunday's nine and 9-1/4 percent, bankers added.
